title: Create charts and visualizations

body.text: — bar, line, pie, scatter, heatmap. Just say what you want to see, and download it as an image file to use.

example: "Create a bar chart comparing quarterly sales, with numbers on the bars, in a blue color scheme"

title: Pick the chart that fits the story

body.text: comparison → bar · trend → line · proportion → pie · relationship → scatter
— tell ChatGPT what story you want the chart to tell, and have it suggest the right type.

example: "What chart should I use to show that sales grew steadily for 6 months? Create it, with the reasoning"
